---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an improvement or new capability
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: []
---

## Problem Statement

What problem are you trying to solve? Describe the use case.

## Proposed Solution

A clear description of what you'd like to see.

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative approaches you've thought about.

## Scope

- [ ] This would require changes to `install.py` (new tool, platform support)
- [ ] This would require changes to `setup.py` (new CLI subcommand, provider)
- [ ] This would require changes to agent files (new persona, permission)
- [ ] This would require changes to MCP server config (new server, tool)
- [ ] This is a documentation change (README, playbook, AGENTS.md)

## Platform Support

If this involves a new OS/distro for the installer:

- **Distro / OS**: [e.g., Fedora, Alpine, FreeBSD]
- **Package manager**: [e.g., dnf, apk, pkg]
- **Tool availability**: Which of the 18 tools have native packages?

## Provider Support

If this involves a new LLM provider:

- **Provider name**: [e.g., Mistral, Groq]
- **API base URL**: [e.g., https://api.mistral.ai/v1]
- **AI SDK adapter**: [npm package name]
- **Model list**: Link to provider's model catalog

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockups, or examples here.
